sections.name: summary
sections.value: Implement u1 from the binding impl-guide: prove the helper red-first, implement bounded publication, wire both generation paths, then collect deterministic and live evidence.

value.title: Add RED session-name publisher tests
value.success: Vitest covers retry success, already-equal readback, permanent failure, status fallback, and one notice.
value.notes: Run the new file before adding the helper and retain the failing receipt.
value.receipt: RED suite failed at missing helper import before implementation; artifact://54.

value.title: Implement bounded session-name publisher
value.success: A pi-free helper retries on the declared schedule, verifies readback when exposed, always publishes status, and reports honest failure.
value.notes: Frozen deps and return type come from impl-guide u1.
value.receipt: just test session-name.test.ts: 4 passed; just typecheck: pass.

value.title: Wire both daemon generation paths
value.success: Rust and legacy session_start paths share the helper; a failed startup gets one extra first-inbound attempt.
value.notes: Keep index.ts changes to the two setSessionName call sites and their shared local state; plan 124 converges nearby.
value.receipt: Both call sites migrated; just typecheck passed.

value.title: Prove deterministic and live acceptance
value.success: AC1-AC4 have command or tmux-capture receipts in the plan assets and every witness window is closed.
value.notes: Hand-start OMP witnesses; never substitute pij-spawned clients.

tk-1251.assertion: Focused helper tests fail before implementation and cover retry success, already-equal readback, permanent failure, unconditional status, and exactly-once notice.
tk-1251.receipt: RED: just test .pi/extensions/pij/core/session-name.test.ts failed because session-name.js did not exist (artifact://54).

tk-1252.assertion: publishSeatName uses only the frozen narrow deps, bounded attempts, and returns took plus attempts without importing pi APIs.
tk-1252.receipt: session-name.ts: pi-free narrow deps, bounded absolute schedule, readback verification, tagged result; focused Vitest 4/4 passed.

tk-1253.assertion: Both daemon generations publish through the shared helper on OMP and perform only one extra first-inbound attempt after startup failure.
tk-1253.receipt: index.ts rust and legacy paths call startOmpSessionNamePublication; first turn schedules one [0] reassert after startup failure.

tk-1254.assertion: Focused tests, typecheck, harness checks, forced-miss transcript, and ten hand-started OMP footer captures satisfy AC1-AC4.
